data.description:
Mirror inventory finding F4 (reports/stability/mirror-inventory.md), MEDIUM, ALREADY DRIFTED (prose).

- src/rebar/graph/_relations.py:17 _BLOCKING_RELATIONS = {"blocks","depends_on"} (canonical)
- src/rebar/graph/_graph.py:210 hardcoded 5-element complement
- src/rebar/graph/_links.py:279 hardcoded positive ("blocks","depends_on"), not importing its sibling

Drift present in prose: both docstrings list only FOUR non-blocking relations, omitting caused_by —
_graph.py:194-196 (two lines above a five-element code list) and _links.py:277-279.

Consequence of a future miss at _graph.py:210: a new non-blocking relation falls to the else:
branch, is cycle-checked as `blocks`, and a valid link is rejected with CyclicDependencyError.

Proposed fix: generate-from-canonical — `return relation not in _BLOCKING_RELATIONS`.
data.title: Blocking/non-blocking relation partition is hardcoded three times; docstrings drifted (mirror F4)
